_effects: Each step's `unavailable` is the crash rule; `effects` adds unresponsive (freeze), slow (delay, CPU, spike) and intermittent (packet loss). `basis` says whether a rule was measured or inferred from code; `observations` are the experiments behind measured rules.

unavailable.latency: Requests to a crashed container can hang until the Gateway's 10 s TimeLimiter before the fallback

unresponsive.behavior: Requests wait up to the Gateway's 10 s TimeLimiter: a longer freeze returns the 503 fallback, a shorter one lets them finish late

slow.behavior: Responses succeed late while the slowdown stays under the 10 s TimeLimiter
slow.latency: CPU limited to 0.1 core: p95 89 ms warm and 460 ms right after a restart, no errors
slow.basis: measured for CPU starvation; network delay inferred
uncertainties: Slowdowns near 10 s trip the TimeLimiter and return the 503 fallback

intermittent.behavior: TCP retransmission hides moderate packet loss at the cost of latency
intermittent.latency: a few hundred ms at 30% loss (measured on visits-service)
uncertainties: Loss approaching 100% behaves like an outage

observations.detail: Requests hung up to the Gateway's 10 s timeout before failing; list owners matched its unavailable prediction

_restart_effects: What a crashed service loses when it starts again. `probe` names the correctness check that can observe it.

visits-service.behavior: The in-memory HSQLDB restarts from seed data, so visits written since the last start are lost
visits-service.data: visits written at runtime are gone

evidence.detail: 379 of 383 owner 6 visits, including the canary, were missing after the restart; the 4 seeded visits remained

customers-service.behavior: Owners and pets written since the last start are lost when the in-memory HSQLDB reloads its seed data
customers-service.data: owners and pets created at runtime are gone
customers-service.basis: inferred: the same embedded HSQLDB setup as visits-service; the load generator creates no owners

evidence.detail: Seed data is loaded into the embedded database at every start
